initialBriefs.tester: BUG-231: Customer entered 12.50 EUR but reservation history showed 0.12. Might be display or rounding. Test it, leave a bug report and regression checks; no production fix. Repository: NOVICE/checkout-boundary.
initialBriefs.developer: TASK-318: Cancellation quote throws. Early refundable bookings return everything, nearer departures about half, late ones nothing; do not change the booking. Deliver a tested patch. Repository: NOVICE/booking-policy.

projects.summary: Checkout amount differs from reservation history
Cancellation refund quote for a booking

fixtures.provenance: Original tracked C02 and C07 incident projects copied unchanged; review-only package.json and Git metadata added; no solutions or prior evidence copied.

evaluation: Discover requirements and separate absent requirements from inferred behavior
Reach actual original failure with meaningful assertions
Tester leaves reproducible bug evidence without a fix; developer preserves assertions and produces a tested patch
Interpret target, invocation status, skips, behavioral proof and native visualizations correctly
Preserve context and leave a resumable handoff
Report observed confusing/misleading UI/documentation transitions with reproducible evidence
constraints: Public product docs/UI first; no prior review/results/solutions/graders
Use product tool API for source access, writes and tests; no direct filesystem or shell test bypass
Only localhost disposable fixtures, isolated reviewer stories
No global config changes or repository pushes by reviewers
Roughly 12 minutes or 40 meaningful tool invocations each
limits: This is expert agents role-playing novice users, not a measured study with human novice participants.
The source cases are real local executable fixtures; external infrastructure and retained semantic examples are synthetic.
No autonomous Qwen/model-backend evaluation or fresh Joern/real environment integration is implied.
